recipes.title: Honey Soy Orange Salmon

items.i: salt, pepper and a little oil
roasted vegetables or grain bowl, to serve

steps: Season the salmon and sear it in a little oil for a few minutes, then flip.
Add the garlic, soy sauce and honey, basting the salmon with the pan sauce as it cooks.
Squeeze in fresh orange juice and let it bubble into a glaze.
Serve over roasted vegetables or a hearty grain bowl, spooning over the sauce.
recipes.notes: Seasoning amounts from the on-screen card; 62 g protein as stated in the title. Salmon amount and other macros are estimates (base not included).
